name: Late gate touch: brush Course 1's start gate from the far side
techNote: The lab's one shape is a 40x40 Ground box buried in the floor (a lab needs a shape); it stands on Course 1's floor right of its start gate (the gate's trigger x 2468-2518, y -343 to -93 in the world frame; the anchor is its centre), facing it, the hurtbox's left edge 2 u from it (the 40x54 box the gates touch; the 41x72 body box's is 1.5 u, but it excludes the gates' layer). The course timer starts on the second tick in a row the hurtbox overlaps the gate (startGate starts it on the Stay; the first tick is the Enter), so a route that got to the far side untimed starts it only when it brushes the gate for two ticks: rest, tap the stick toward the gate and back, and the hurtbox touches the gate (the finish box is the gate: the lab finishes on the first overlap, a tick before the game's timer would start). docs/course-timer.md.
